general: Only when the source shows a full-bleed pale pink #f3dcd4 background with sage-green #8aa597 headphones on the left, keep the background full-bleed and assign any extra width or height to the background around the product, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows the product on the left and a text stack on the right, keep the product in the left 55% of the canvas and the text stack in the right 45% of the canvas, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows the headphones uncropped and fully visible, keep them at approximately 37% of the canvas width and 72% of the canvas height centred in the left zone, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a vertical text stack, keep its order as brand word on top, two-line headline below it, price below the headline, and sage-green CTA rectangle below the price, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a sage-green #8aa597 CTA rectangle, keep it fixed at approximately 19% of the canvas width and 11% of the canvas height below the price and do not stretch it with the canvas, otherwise keep the source structure.
Only when the source shows black #1d1d1d text on the pale pink background, keep all copy black except the white CTA label and introduce no other text colours, otherwise keep the source structure.
never: Never add a logo, badge, sticker, discount burst, or additional price element not visible in the source.
Never add extra bands, tabs, panels, frames, borders, or background shapes behind the product or text.
Never add additional buttons, icons, or English copy not visible in the source.
text: All visible copy is Hebrew in RTL order, centre-aligned within the right-hand text block.
Headline is the largest bold black #1d1d1d text, set over two lines below the smaller bold brand word.
Price is smaller bold black text below the headline, above the CTA.
CTA label is smaller white Hebrew text centred inside the sage-green #8aa597 rectangle.
